name: Son Doong
summary: Do not add this after the boat cave. Oxalis runs it as six days and five nights, from January to August, and there is no walk-up ticket. The park page and the operator both print 3,000 USD a person. The operator also prints 80,000,000 VND. Be in Dong Hoi by 15:00 for the briefing.
getThere: Dong Hoi by 15:00, then the briefing
heroCaption: A sunbeam in the first doline, with a person on the rock for scale

notice.title: 2027 and 2028 are fully booked
notice.body: The operator’s page, checked 21 Oct 2026, says those departures are full. A seat in another season is still not a ticket at the Tourism Center.

body: You do not buy this at the pier. Be in Dong Hoi by 15:00. The operator transfers you to Phong Nha, and the briefing that evening is compulsory. At 17:00 the group visits the Phong Nha Caves Exploration Museum, then the briefing. Pack the porter bag before 07:00 the next morning. The group leaves at 08:00, along Road 20 and the west Ho Chi Minh road, to the trailhead at kilometre 35. That day is a 14-kilometre trek, with about 30 knee-deep river crossings, a stop in Doong village of the Bru–Vân Kiều, and a walk through Hang En. The park’s day list camps that night at Hang En. The operator’s current itinerary camps near the Son Doong entrance after Hang En, and enters the main cave the next day.

Inside, the park describes a jungle 252 metres down in a doline, and a wall of 90 metres climbed with ladders and ropes. The operator splits that wall into an 18-metre ladder and a 72-metre ascent, and describes an 80-metre descent from an upper passage to the cave floor on the day you enter. That passage is about 700 metres, with sections it describes as 100 metres wide. A local man, Ho Khanh, found the entrance in 1990. A British-Vietnamese survey announced it in 2009. Oxalis has run the trek since 2013. The operator prints 18 to 24°C inside the cave. Groups are capped at 10. The park page says the support team is more than 30 people.

Skip it if you have a few days. The morning in the village is the boat. Paradise Cave is the dry walk, on its own ticket. This one takes the week. The join-in age is 18 to 70. A private departure is a different price and was not copied.

figures.caption: The sandy floor inside the opening, on the way through the trek
figures.alt: A sandy floor and a stream inside a large cave opening at Son Doong

gettingThere: You do not start at the village pier. Oxalis wants you in Dong Hoi by 15:00 for the transfer to Phong Nha and the briefing that evening. The road minutes from the airport to that briefing are check on arrival. The trek starts the next morning at kilometre 35 on the west Ho Chi Minh road.

legs.heading: From Dong Hoi
legs.body: Arrive by 15:00. The transfer to Phong Nha and the evening briefing are compulsory. At 17:00 the operator takes the group to the Phong Nha Caves Exploration Museum, then to the briefing. The road minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Phong Nha village
legs.body: You sleep here after the briefing. Pack the porter bag before 07:00. The group leaves at 08:00 for kilometre 35 on the west Ho Chi Minh road. Minutes from the village to that trailhead are check on arrival.

hours: January to August. Departures follow the operator calendar, not a daily gate.
closed: No walk-up entry. The operator’s page, checked 21 Oct 2026, says the 2027 and 2028 departures are fully booked. The pack does not run outside January to August.
admissionNote: Join-in group of 10. The park page prints 3,000 USD a person. The Oxalis page prints 3,000 USD and 80,000,000 VND a person, and says the price includes VAT. The pack generated on 17 Oct 2026 printed the same two figures. Age 18 to 70. A private departure is a different price and was not copied. The park page also confirms Oxalis since 2013, January to August, a maximum of 10 guests, and about 1,000 visitors a year. It does not print the dong figure.
